meta.title: A draft award proposal records the event, lot and Excel mode
gaps: The setup vocabulary has no recipe for an event with lots or an allocation summary template.
open_proposal has no supported fields for selecting lot 2 or Excel awarding mode.
The proposal read-back fields are not sampled, so the event number, lot 2, creator, awarding-by-Excel flag, and allocation summary v1 cannot be asserted.
the part about “excel” is outside what an API plan on a sourcing event checks

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with one QA vendor invited, no bids, and its bidding window (with the extra closing time) already over.
steps: The buyer opens an award proposal.
The buyer reads the award proposal.
As the buyer, read the award proposal and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
